evidence.reading: What the study data actually shows (correcting the first-draft narrative): (1) EVERY completed trial — including the most regularized (trial 8, lambda_l2=5) — sits at gap 0.10–0.14; the spec's 0.025 alarm level is unreachable anywhere in the frozen search space, so the gap is a property of boosted trees on this data, not a tunable pathology. (2) Across the 8 completed trials, gap shows no relationship with OOF AUC (r=-0.065 — with n=8 this correlation is itself statistically uninformative; the range argument in (1) is the load-bearing evidence, not the r value). (3) The deployed config in fact has among the SMALLEST gaps while achieving the best OOF. The alarm did its job — it forced this audit; the audit's verdict is benign memorization, with the one-shot holdout as final adjudicator (playbook step 5) in Phase 7.

playbook_step5_check: if holdout later disagrees badly with OOF, CV was leaking — Phase 7 will test this
confidence_caveats: n=8 completed trials: the correlation estimate is noise; the range argument (all trials gap 0.10-0.14, alarm unreachable in the frozen space) carries the adjudication

convergence claim is LOCAL: two configs from the same low-lr neighborhood reaching identical OOF is neighborhood-plateau evidence, not proof of the global optimum; the study is resumable (make tune) and the recorded search contains a time-cap bias against the slowest corner (lr<~0.013), stated in MODELING.md
